# Integration, Testing, and Troubleshooting
---

**Sheduled time:** 4.30PM - 5.00PM

**Primary focus:** Demonstrating that the complete system works and explaining technical decisions

## Objective

Verify the completed Directus–React integration. Directus already provides the backend API, so you are not required to create a separate REST API.

The assessor must be able to follow a message from the React form into Directus and back into the React list.


## Task 1 – End-to-End Demonstration

Perform the following demonstration with the assessor:

1. Start Directus and the React development server from a stopped state.
2. Open the Contact and Feedback page.
3. Show messages loaded from Directus.
4. Submit a new valid message through the React form.
5. Show the success state and the newly submitted message in the React list.
6. Open Directus Data Studio and show the same stored record.

Record the test message subject and resulting Directus item ID.

| Item | Candidate response |
|---|---|
| Test subject | |
| Directus item ID | |
| Test result | Pass / Fail |


## Task 2 – Functional Test Record

Complete and execute the tests below.

| Test | Expected result | Actual result | Pass? | Evidence reference |
|---|---|---|:---:|---|
| Initial message load | Records appear newest first | | ☐ |  |
| Valid submission | Item stored and list updated | | ☐ | |
| Missing required field | Inline validation shown; no item created | | ☐ |  |
| Invalid email | Validation shown; no item created | | ☐ |  |
| Empty collection/result | Empty state shown | | ☐ | |
| Repeated submit click | Only one item created | | ☐ | |
| Unauthorised update/delete | Request is denied | | ☐ |   |

You may temporarily alter data, permissions, or configuration to create a test condition.


## Task 3 – Browser and API Inspection

Use browser developer tools to inspect at least one read request and one create request.

For each, identify:

- request method and URL;
- relevant response data; and
- whether sensitive information is exposed.

Attach evidence with tokens, credentials, personal details, and other secrets removed.


## Task 4 – Short Technical Explanation

Be prepared to explain, without reading directly from your source code:

- how the Directus SDK client is configured;
- how a submitted form becomes a Directus item;
- how the list is refreshed after submission;
- why your access configuration is safe enough for this assessment; and
- one improvement you would make before production deployment.


## Integration Deliverables

☐ Successful end-to-end demonstration  
☐ Completed functional test record  
☐ Read and create request evidence  
☐ Troubleshooting notes
